## 5. Security Research & Vulnerability Disclosures

- **Program:** Google Vulnerability Reward Program (VRP)
- **Publication:** InfoSec Write-ups (Medium)
- **URL:** https://infosecwriteups.com/gemini-app-logical-lockscreen-bypass-9e7da290ea06

## 6. Featured Software Projects

### 1. ShadowLab
- **Repository:** https://github.com/msalihberk/ShadowLab
- **Description:** Modular, Python-based Command-and-Control (C2) framework designed for cybersecurity research, custom socket communication, and payload management. Features encrypted communication, agent generation, and multi-agent control mechanisms.
- **Tech Keywords:** Python, Networking, C2 Architecture, Socket Programming, Encryption

### 2. Prox CLI (`prox-cli`)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/msalihberk/prox-cli
- **Description:** Lightweight, extensible multi-tool command-line interface (CLI) suite built with Go for developers and security workflows.
- **Tech Keywords:** Go (Golang), CLI Tools, DevOps, Utility Engineering
